description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing the core.fsmonitor feature in Git. It sets up different test scenarios to evaluate the performance impacts of file system change monitors like Watchman, including configuration setup, cache dropping, and various status and diff commands execution to benchmark the feature's effectiveness.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Starts trace logging by setting up GIT_TRACE2_PERF with a specified filename based on the test case name.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting GIT_TRACE2_PERF.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates specified number of files with sequential names inside a directory.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test with a descriptive label and a shell command sequence expected to succeed.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Sets up the fsmonitor hook configuration, choosing the appropriate integration script based on environment variables and the presence of Watchman.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests with optional OS cache dropping based on environment variable.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Runs a series of performance tests (status, diff, add) with specific configurations to evaluate fsmonitor performance.
